Bounded quarter-mm phases/private repositions preserve continuous geometry;initial grid misses are distinct from final interval ranges. Equal five-cycle conventional zigzags show three states of one apparatus,not literal measured helix length. Shorter/equilibrium/longer wire layouts have independent actual cadence;no inherited fixed gap. Final per-path maxima and local trials retained;no global optimum/physical traceability/device fit claim.
